states.candidate: Works, with thin evidence so far.
states.experimental: Coherent method and trigger boundary, no real-work use yet.

versioning.policy: Each skill carries a version in its SKILL.md frontmatter. The number tracks the skill as a document, not the tool it wraps.
versioning.major: The method changed: a phase added or removed, a reordered flow, a renamed reference. Anyone following the old version gets different results.
versioning.minor: Material added or a claim corrected without changing the flow.
versioning.reaching-1.0.0: A skill reaches 1.0.0 when it is stable: run on real work, with the evidence recorded. Candidates stay on 0.x, which is the honest signal that the contract can still move.

supply-chain-audit.summary: Written and run during the 2025-2026 npm compromise wave, against real machines under a live disclosure. Ships a versioned IOC pack covering Shai-Hulud 2.0, Mini Shai-Hulud / TeamPCP, and Axios DPRK, and finds the artifacts it claims to.

obsidian-plugin-release.summary: Used to ship real releases of an Obsidian community plugin, including passing the automated community review. The atomic version bump and the provenance attestation both verified on live releases.

generate-brand-assets.summary: Used to generate the OG images and favicons on shipped Crafter Station projects. Outputs land ready to integrate at the sizes the social platforms actually want.

intent-layer.summary: Used to set up the AGENTS.md hierarchy on real repositories, where it measurably improved how agents navigate them. Built on The Intent Layer method by Tyler Brandt.

skill-gen.summary: Generated skills from documentation with Firecrawl. In practice the output needed enough rewriting that authoring the SKILL.md by hand was faster. Kept installable for provenance, no longer recommended.

surface-recon.summary: Distilled from 21 recon reports, then run against a live target across three readings that each corrected the previous one. Its friction log added seven gates, including reproducing without credentials before blaming your account, distinguishing a maintenance window from a block, and noticing when a verdict survives a correction to the premise it rested on.

cli-build.summary: Distilled from 14 CLIs with real code, four of them published, then run end to end twice on the same build. The two runs caught five defects that survived a clean typecheck and 59 green tests, produced twelve corrections, and now delegate primitive adoption to cligentic's package.json-capable canonical skill.
